name: p2-paxos-source-provenance
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/p2-paxos-atomic-export.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/emission.log" 2>&1; for f in PaxosEprAtomicDefs.lean source-machine.json source-laws.json basis.json SOURCE-EMISSION.json; do cmp "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/$f" "research/bapa/paxos-accepted-capsule/$f"; done; cp research/protocols/ic3syn/p2-paxos-source-input.ts "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/p2-paxos-source-input.ts"; sha256sum research/protocols/ic3syn/p2-paxos-source-input.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/common.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/SOURCE-PORT.sha256"; printf 'PASS: all four emitted artifacts and SOURCE-EMISSION.json match accepted capsule byte for byte\n' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/REPRODUCTION.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/p2-paxos-source-provenance-commit.txt > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1
